zh.title: 黎猫工具箱 · 基础设置
zh.error: 操作未完成，请检查连接或所选文件后重试。
zh.guardBehavior: 启动保护开启时接管现有 DSH 快捷方式，关闭时按备份还原。
zh.guardScope: 保留手动改动；不保证覆盖 Windows 11 缓存的固定项或直接启动原始 exe。
zh.permission_denied: 已被阻止，请在浏览器或系统设置中修改
zh.timeStatsHint: 在对话框下方显示当前任务的进行时间与完成耗时。
zh.modelSelectionHint: 使用卡片选择模型、推理等级、速度与输出详略。
zh.fileMenuHint: 任务中的文件增加右键操作。
zh.autostartUnsupported: 此项目前支持 Windows 登录后自动启动。
zh.autostartChanged: 自启动入口已被手动修改，请先手动处理该入口后重试。
zh.category_pluginsHint: 包含插件的待更新，更新错误，更新中等。
zh.category_tasksHint: 包含任务的进行中、已完成、待补充、错误等。
zh.systemNotificationsHint: 当应用未聚焦/最小化/收起的时候会发送系统消息。
zh.bubblesHint: 对应的消息会以气泡形式持久提示。
zh.enhancedModelsHint: 模型设置界面重新排版
zh.componentRestart: 新组件尚未加载，请完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 后重新打开。
zh.protectionHint: 启动前检测并停用会导致闪退的第三方插件，以及清理过期Cookie。
zh.componentToggleFailed: 组件开关未能应用，请重试。已保存的设置会保留。
zh.componentOverridden: 此开关被优先级更高的配置覆盖，请检查额外配置。
zh.componentRestartRequired: 设置已保存；DSH 报告部分变更需完全退出并重新打开后生效。
zh.sessionListHint: 修改会话列表的显示，并且增加右键菜单。

en.title: Tanuki Toolbox · Basic settings
en.audioLimit: MP3, WAV and OGG only, up to 5 MiB.
en.error: The action failed. Check the connection or selected file and retry.
en.guardBehavior: Enabling startup guard takes over existing DSH shortcuts; disabling restores their backups.
en.guardScope: Manual changes are preserved. Cached Windows 11 pins or launching the original exe directly may not be covered.
en.permission_denied: Blocked; change browser or system settings
en.timeStatsHint: Show running and completed turn durations below the composer.
en.modelSelectionHint: Use compact controls for model, effort, speed, and output detail.
en.fileMenuHint: Add right-click actions to files in tasks.
en.autostartHint: Start DeepSeekHarness automatically after signing in.
en.autostartUnsupported: Automatic startup currently supports Windows sign-in.
en.autostartChanged: The startup entry was manually changed. Resolve it manually before retrying.
en.category_pluginsHint: Plugin updates available, update errors, updates in progress, and more.
en.category_tasksHint: Tasks in progress, completed, awaiting input, failed, and more.
en.inAppHint: Message banners at the top of the application.
en.systemNotificationsHint: Send system notifications when the app is unfocused, minimized, or hidden.
en.bubblesHint: Show persistent notification badges beside the relevant items.
en.soundHint: Play a sound with message notifications.
en.componentRestart: This new component has not loaded yet. Quit DeepSeek Harness completely, then reopen it.
en.protectionHint: Check and disable crash-causing third-party plugins before startup, and clean up expired cookies.
en.componentToggleFailed: The component change could not be applied. Retry; saved settings are retained.
en.componentOverridden: A higher-priority configuration overrides this switch. Check additional configuration.
en.componentRestartRequired: Saved. DSH reports that some changes require quitting and reopening the application.
en.sessionListHint: Adjust the conversation list and add its native actions to the right-click menu.
